strategies.name: Long Call
strategies.description: Buy a call: unlimited upside with premium at risk. The purest bullish expression with a convex payoff and no liquidation risk.

strategies.name: Long Everlasting Call
strategies.description: Everlasting call with no expiry: holds convexity indefinitely and pays funding each period instead of decaying to zero.

strategies.name: Deep ITM Call (Stock Replacement)
strategies.description: High-delta deep-in-the-money call replicates spot with far less capital at risk and no liquidation engine.

strategies.name: Bull Call Spread
strategies.description: Buy ATM call, sell OTM call: cheaper bullish exposure with capped upside and far lower theta bleed.

strategies.name: Bull Put Spread (Credit)
strategies.description: Sell OTM put, buy further OTM put. Collects credit; profits if the market holds or rises. Defined tail risk.

strategies.name: Everlasting Bull Call Spread
strategies.description: Perpetual call debit spread: long ATM everlasting call, short OTM everlasting call — no rolls, funding-net carry.

strategies.name: Poor Man's Covered Call
strategies.description: Long-dated deep ITM call financed by short near-dated OTM calls: covered-call economics at a fraction of the capital.

strategies.name: ZEBRA (Zero-Extrinsic Back Ratio)
strategies.description: Buy two ITM calls, sell one ATM call: ~100 delta stock replica with near-zero extrinsic value at entry.

strategies.name: Call Ratio Spread 1x2
strategies.description: Sell one ATM call, buy two OTM calls: cheap or free bullish structure with doubled upside beyond the wing.

strategies.name: Call Backspread
strategies.description: Sell ITM call, buy two OTM calls: often entered for even or credit, with unlimited profit on a strong rally.

strategies.name: Bull Call Ladder
strategies.description: Buy ATM call, sell two higher strikes: the shorts finance the long, capping profit above the top strike.

strategies.name: Bullish Seagull
strategies.description: Short OTM put funds a long call spread: near zero-cost bullish structure with downside risk below the put.

strategies.name: Bullish Risk Reversal
strategies.description: Sell OTM put, buy OTM call: the classic near-zero-cost bullish structure used to express direction with skew.

strategies.name: Synthetic Long
strategies.description: Buy call, sell put at the same strike: replicates the forward with no spot outlay and clean margin treatment.

strategies.name: Covered Call
strategies.description: Own spot, sell calls against it: the classic income overlay that monetizes a flat-to-bullish view.

strategies.name: Covered Call on Perp
strategies.description: Long perpetual future with a short everlasting call: continuous premium collection with no expiry to roll.

strategies.name: Call Calendar Spread
strategies.description: Sell near-dated, buy far-dated call at the same strike: profits from the steep front of the theta curve into expiry.

strategies.name: Diagonal Call Spread
strategies.description: Long far-dated ITM call, short near-dated OTM call: PMCC-style diagonal with rollable structure.

strategies.name: Call Ratio Spread 1x3
strategies.description: Buy one ATM call, sell three OTM calls: large credit with naked upside risk above the short strike — for range-bound bulls.

strategies.name: Strap
strategies.description: Two calls plus one put at the money: long volatility with a bullish tilt — double payoff on the upside.

strategies.name: Long Put
strategies.description: Buy a put: convex downside exposure that accelerates as price falls, with premium at risk only.

strategies.name: Long Everlasting Put
strategies.description: Perpetual put: permanent crash protection that pays off at any time, funded by period payments.

strategies.name: Bear Put Spread
strategies.description: Buy ATM put, sell OTM put: defined-risk bearish structure at reduced cost with capped downside capture.

strategies.name: Bear Call Spread (Credit)
strategies.description: Sell call, buy higher call: collect credit in a falling or flat market with defined upside risk.

strategies.name: Everlasting Bear Put Spread
strategies.description: Perpetual put debit spread: durable bearish exposure without expiry risk, net funding carry positive.

strategies.name: Protective Put
strategies.description: Hold spot and buy an OTM put: full upside with a hard floor — the benchmark institutional hedge.

strategies.name: Put Backspread
strategies.description: Sell one put, buy two lower puts: convex crash exposure often entered for even, paying multiples on a tail move.

strategies.name: Put Ratio Spread 1x2
strategies.description: Buy one ATM put, sell two OTM puts: cheap bearish with re-inverted risk if the market collapses through the wing.

strategies.name: Bear Put Ladder
strategies.description: Buy ATM put, sell two lower puts: the shorts finance the long, capping profit in a deep decline.

strategies.name: Bearish Seagull
strategies.description: Short call funds a long put spread: zero-cost bearish structure with upside risk above the short call.

strategies.name: Bearish Risk Reversal
strategies.description: Sell OTM call, buy OTM put: near-zero-cost bearish structure; the staple of macro hedging desks.

strategies.name: Synthetic Short
strategies.description: Sell call, buy put at the same strike: replicates a short forward without borrowing spot.

strategies.name: Put Calendar Spread
strategies.description: Sell near-dated, buy far-dated put at the same strike: monetizes front theta while keeping term-structure exposure.

strategies.name: Diagonal Put Spread
strategies.description: Long far-dated ITM put, short near-dated OTM put: a rollable bearish diagonal with reduced carry.

strategies.name: Strip
strategies.description: Two puts plus one call at the money: long volatility with a bearish tilt — double payoff on the downside.

strategies.name: Long Straddle
strategies.description: Buy ATM call and put: pure long gamma and vega — profits from any large move, bleeds theta while waiting.

strategies.name: Long Strangle
strategies.description: Buy OTM call and OTM put: cheaper than a straddle with a wider breakeven — the classic tail bet.

strategies.name: Everlasting Straddle
strategies.description: Long everlasting call and put: permanent long-gamma posture funded by period payments — no expiry to fight.

strategies.name: Everlasting Strangle
strategies.description: Perpetual OTM call + put: always-on tail exposure without roll decay, carried via funding.

strategies.name: Long Guts
strategies.description: Buy ITM call and ITM put: deep-intrinsic strangle with high delta on both sides — heavy but responsive.

strategies.name: Calendar Straddle
strategies.description: Sell near-dated straddle, buy far-dated straddle: long back-month vol, short front-month pin risk.

strategies.name: Reverse Iron Condor
strategies.description: Buy the wings, sell the body: defined-debit long-vol structure that profits from a break beyond either wing.

strategies.name: Reverse Iron Butterfly
strategies.description: Buy OTM wings, sell ATM body: the defined-risk way to be long a break in either direction.

strategies.name: Reverse Call Butterfly
strategies.description: Sell two ATM calls, buy ITM and OTM calls: long break-out through either call wing.

strategies.name: Reverse Put Butterfly
strategies.description: Sell two ATM puts, buy ITM and OTM puts: long a large move through either put wing.

strategies.name: Wide Strangle Ladder
strategies.description: Two OTM puts and two OTM calls at increasing distances: laddered convexity for an extended regime break.

strategies.name: Long Vol Term Stack
strategies.description: Strangles at 30d and 90d: stacked long vol across the term structure to smooth theta and event timing.

strategies.name: Everlasting Vol Stack
strategies.description: Everlasting strangles at short and long funding periods: always-on vol exposure across funding tenors.

strategies.name: Reverse Christmas Tree (Puts)
strategies.description: Ratio put structure inverted for long downside vol: buy three puts, sell one higher and two lower.

strategies.name: Sydney (Straddle-Strangle Hybrid)
strategies.description: Two straddles plus one strangle: amplified long-gamma position for an expected violent move.

strategies.name: Short Straddle
strategies.description: Sell ATM call and put: maximum theta collection, unlimited risk both ways — the professional pin trade.

strategies.name: Short Strangle
strategies.description: Sell OTM call and put: collects premium outside an expected range with room to be wrong — naked tails.

strategies.name: Iron Condor
strategies.description: Sell an OTM put spread and call spread: the defined-risk income staple of every professional book.

strategies.name: Iron Butterfly
strategies.description: Sell ATM straddle, buy OTM wings: max credit at the pin with defined tails — aggressive but bounded.

strategies.name: Everlasting Iron Condor
strategies.description: Perpetual iron condor: continuous premium harvesting from mean reversion, hedged wings, no expiry.

strategies.name: Everlasting Iron Butterfly
strategies.description: Short everlasting straddle with purchased wings: pin-risk economics carried through funding periods.

strategies.name: Call Butterfly
strategies.description: Buy one ITM, sell two ATM, buy one OTM call: cheap pin bet with the maximum at the middle strike.

strategies.name: Put Butterfly
strategies.description: Buy one ITM, sell two ATM, buy one OTM put: the put-side mirror of the call butterfly.

strategies.name: Call Condor
strategies.description: All-call condor: buy, sell, sell, buy at rising strikes — a wide flat-topped pin structure.

strategies.name: Put Condor
strategies.description: All-put condor: the mirror of the call condor for the same neutral pin thesis.

strategies.name: Short Guts
strategies.description: Sell ITM call and ITM put: large credit, high probability of retaining a slice, naked tails.

strategies.name: Jade Lizard
strategies.description: Short put plus short call spread: no upside risk if the call spread is wide enough — the classic neutral credit combo.

strategies.name: Big Lizard
strategies.description: Short strangle with a long OTM call wing: retains the credit while capping the upside tail.

strategies.name: Reverse Jade Lizard
strategies.description: Short call plus short put spread: mirror lizard with downside capped by the put spread.

strategies.name: Broken Wing Butterfly (Call)
strategies.description: Call fly with an unbalanced upper wing: entered near zero-cost, keeps a credit zone below the body.

strategies.name: Broken Wing Butterfly (Put)
strategies.description: Put fly with an unbalanced lower wing: zero-cost put-side variant with a credit floor above the body.

strategies.name: Double Calendar
strategies.description: Call calendar plus put calendar at different strikes: twin theta engines with a wide profit tent.

strategies.name: Double Diagonal
strategies.description: Diagonal call spread plus diagonal put spread: income structure that morphs into an iron condor at expiry.

strategies.name: Christmas Tree Condor (Calls)
strategies.description: 1-3-2 call tree: buy one ITM, sell three ATM, buy two OTM — heavy pin exposure for a tiny debit.

strategies.name: Cash-Secured Put
strategies.description: Sell an OTM put against reserved cash: get paid to bid below the market — the wheel's first half.

strategies.name: Everlasting Wheel
strategies.description: Short everlasting put and short everlasting call: the wheel without assignment — rent both sides forever.

strategies.name: Covered Strangle
strategies.description: Own spot, sell OTM call and OTM put against it: double premium with an assignment bid below.

strategies.name: Front Call Calendar
strategies.description: Sell the 14d call, buy the 45d call at the same strike: rapid theta capture with a rollable back month.

strategies.name: Put Credit Ladder
strategies.description: Sell puts at three descending strikes: laddered credit collection that averages into a dip.

strategies.name: Collar
strategies.description: Long spot, long OTM put, short OTM call: floor and ceiling around inventory — the institutional standard.

strategies.name: Zero-Cost Collar
strategies.description: Collar struck so the call finances the put: protection with no premium outlay.

strategies.name: Fence
strategies.description: Collar plus an extra short put: cheapens the hedge further at the cost of a lower floor.

strategies.name: Put Spread Collar
strategies.description: Long spot hedged with a long put spread: cheaper floor with a step-down zone of protection.

strategies.name: Convex Tail Hedge
strategies.description: Long OTM put plus double long further OTM put: negative-carry position with escalating crash payoff.

strategies.name: Crash Protection Ladder
strategies.description: Four puts at descending strikes: laddered disaster insurance that layers in as the market falls.

strategies.name: Everlasting Tail Hedge
strategies.description: Two everlasting OTM puts: always-on crash insurance carried through funding — no expiry cliff.

strategies.name: Protective Everlasting Put
strategies.description: Hold spot with an everlasting put floor: permanent insurance without roll execution risk.

strategies.name: Everlasting Collar
strategies.description: Long spot with everlasting put floor and everlasting call ceiling: a self-financing band held indefinitely.

strategies.name: Delta-Hedged Long Call
strategies.description: Long call with a short perp overlay: strips direction, isolates gamma and vega — the market-maker building block.

strategies.name: Term-Structure Vol Hedge
strategies.description: Long 30d straddle against a short everlasting straddle: trades realized carry against funding carry.

strategies.name: Portfolio Guard Ladder
strategies.description: Three descending puts financed by one covered call: self-funding insurance grid for a spot book.

strategies.name: Box Spread
strategies.description: Synthetic long plus synthetic short at different strikes: a fixed payoff used to price and borrow at options rates.

strategies.name: Conversion
strategies.description: Long spot, short call, long put at the same strike: pins the forward — the classic put-call parity trade.

strategies.name: Reversal
strategies.description: Short perp, long call, short put at the same strike: the reverse conversion — parity in the other direction.

strategies.name: Time Butterfly
strategies.description: Short two mid-expiry calls, long near and far expiry calls: isolates the term structure around one date.

strategies.name: Diagonal Condor
strategies.description: Condor built across two expiries: back-month wings, front-month body — term-structured income.

strategies.name: Unbalanced Iron Condor
strategies.description: Iron condor with doubled put side: skews the structure to lean bullish while collecting on both wings.

strategies.name: Skip-Strike Butterfly
strategies.description: Butterfly with a gap between body and wing: wider profit zone for a lower debit than the plain fly.

strategies.name: Albatross Condor
strategies.description: Extra-wide iron condor with distant wings: slow-decaying, high-buffer income for patient books.

strategies.name: Put Ratio 1x2 (Income)
strategies.description: Buy one OTM put, sell two further OTM puts: credit generation with tail risk through the lower strike.

strategies.name: Unbalanced Butterfly
strategies.description: 2-3-1 call butterfly with skewed wings: leans the pin zone toward the upside while keeping defined risk.

strategies.name: Calendar Iron Condor
strategies.description: Front-month iron condor with back-month wings: theta harvest that keeps long-dated protection in place.

strategies.name: Hedged Call Condor
strategies.description: Call condor with a long OTM put rider: defined structures on both sides for event windows.

strategies.name: Everlasting Cash-Secured Put
strategies.description: Short everlasting OTM put: continuous premium on a bid below market, carried by funding with no expiry.

strategies.name: Everlasting Covered Call (Long Funding)
strategies.description: Perp plus short everlasting call on a 14-day funding period: slower bleed, steadier income stream.

strategies.name: Everlasting Straddle (Long Funding)
strategies.description: Everlasting straddle on a 30-day funding period: long vol carried at the slow end of the funding curve.

strategies.name: Everlasting Risk Reversal
strategies.description: Short everlasting put, long everlasting call: persistent near-zero-cost bullish posture in funding space.

strategies.name: Everlasting Butterfly
strategies.description: Everlasting 0.94-1.0-1.06 fly: pin exposure that persists across funding periods without expiry gamma cliff.

strategies.name: Everlasting Funding Structure
strategies.description: Short 30-day-funding put against long 7-day-funding put: trades the funding term structure itself.

strategies.name: Everlasting Collar on Perp
strategies.description: Long perp with everlasting put floor and call ceiling: a funding-space band around a perpetual position.

strategies.name: Everlasting ZEBRA
strategies.description: Two everlasting ITM calls against one ATM: perpetual stock replica with minimal extrinsic load.

strategies.name: Delta-Hedged Strip (8 Legs)
strategies.description: Straddle plus strangle plus a calendar leg, hedged with a perp: an eight-leg gamma book built like a desk position.

strategies.name: Income Ladder (10 Legs)
strategies.description: Five short calls and five short puts laddered by strike: an income grid that averages credit across the range.

strategies.name: Ladder Condor (10 Legs)
strategies.description: Put ladder plus call ladder around a short ATM straddle: ten legs of layered mean-reversion harvest.

strategies.name: Grand Christmas Tree (12 Legs)
strategies.description: Call tree and put tree at two expiries: twelve legs of ratio-structured pin harvesting across time.

strategies.name: Term-Structure Ladder (12 Legs)
strategies.description: Calls at four strikes across three expiries: a twelve-leg ladder that layers direction over the whole curve.

strategies.name: Spectrum Condor (16 Legs)
strategies.description: Four iron condors at 7/14/30/60 days: sixteen legs of expiring and rolling income across the maturity spectrum.

strategies.name: Terraced Put Ladder (15 Legs)
strategies.description: Five short near-dated puts, five bought mid-dated, five bought far-dated: a terraced put structure across time.

strategies.name: Butterfly Mesh (18 Legs)
strategies.description: Call and put butterflies at three expiries: an eighteen-leg mesh of pin zones layered across the calendar.

strategies.name: Perpetual Income Grid (20 Legs)
strategies.description: Ten everlasting puts at descending strikes on two funding periods: a twenty-leg always-on income grid.

strategies.name: Convexity Cascade (21 Legs)
strategies.description: Twenty-one puts in an escalating ratio cascade across three expiries: engineered crash convexity.

strategies.name: Vol Surface Portfolio (25 Legs)
strategies.description: Strangle spreads at five expiries plus an everlasting strangle, perp hedge and spot anchor: a twenty-five-leg book spanning the whole surface.

strategies.name: Full Spectrum (25 Legs)
strategies.description: The showcase maximum: calls, puts, everlasting options, a perp and spot — every instrument class in one twenty-five-leg structure.

strategies.name: 0DTE Iron Condor
strategies.description: Same-day iron condor: sell the ±2% wings, buy protection one step further. Pure theta harvest on the final day of decay with explosive gamma risk — the highest-octane income structure in the catalog.

strategies.name: 0DTE Iron Fly
strategies.description: Same-day iron fly: sell the ATM straddle, buy the ±3% wings. Maximum credit at maximum pin risk — for desks expecting the spot to magnetize to the strike into the expiry print.

strategies.name: 0DTE Put Credit Spread
strategies.description: Same-day bull put spread: sell the ~1.5% OTM put, buy the next strike down. Collects the full day of decay when spot holds above the short strike.

strategies.name: 0DTE Call Credit Spread
strategies.description: Same-day bear call spread: sell the ~1.5% OTM call, buy the next strike up. The mirror image credit play for fades and rejection days.

strategies.name: 0DTE Long Straddle
strategies.description: Buy the same-day ATM straddle: unlimited gamma into the last hours of the cycle. The purest expression of 'today moves more than the market priced'.

strategies.name: 0DTE Long Strangle
strategies.description: Buy the same-day ±3% strangle: cheaper gamma than the straddle with a wider breakeven. For tail days — CPI, FOMC, liquidation cascades.

strategies.name: 0DTE Broken Wing Butterfly
strategies.description: Same-day unbalanced fly: skip-strike wings so the structure costs near zero and pins a directional bias. The 0DTE scalper's precision instrument.

strategies.name: Condor Roll Ladder
strategies.description: Multihop income book: three iron condors laddered across 30/60/90-day expiries. As each cycle expires it rolls to the back — a perpetual premium harvest machine with staggered gamma risk.

strategies.name: Credit Spread Roll Ladder
strategies.description: Multihop bullish income: put credit spreads stacked at 14/30/60-day cycles. Each cycle rolls up and out as it profits — compounding small credits into a serious carry stream.

strategies.name: Calendar Roll Ladder
strategies.description: Multihop term-structure book: calendars at staggered 30/60/90-day fronts. The short fronts decay and roll while the long backs hold vega — a rolling carry machine that stays long the term structure.

strategies.name: Double Diagonal Roll
strategies.description: The professional's rolling income core: short 30d strangle wings against long 60d protection. Adjusts by rolling the shorts when tested — the canonical multihop management structure.

strategies.name: ZEBRA 45d
strategies.description: Zero-Extrinsic Back Ratio on dated options: two ~70-delta calls financed by one ATM short. Synthetic-stock payoff with no extrinsic bleed — the leverage-efficient directional multileg.

strategies.name: Straddle Back-Ratio Roll
strategies.description: Multihop long-gamma core: short 30d ATM straddle against two 60d straddles. Profits from the roll-down of the term structure while keeping the long-dated gamma — the vol-desk's classic carry-gamma hybrid.
